desc:
Dive into the extensive world of Five Nights at Freddy’s : The Pizzeria Roleplay Remastered! Play as your favorite characters from EVERY corner of Fnaf, and meet a few new faces along the way! Explore different eras of the franchise, from Fredbear’s all the way to the PizzaPlex, and uncover the horrors hidden behind these checkered walls. 

🎮Each map has unique quests, achievements, and secrets to discover! Play minigames, complete quests and survive the night to collect coins and tickets to unlock new characters, map skins, and more! 

🏗️Express yourself with our custom character creator, and build your very own pizzerias in our map editor! 

🎉Make friends and memories with hundreds of characters and endless roleplay possibilities! 

⚙️ Semi-frequent updates with new characters, customization options, QOL features and bug fixes! 

📋 This is a fangame based on Scott Cawthon’s Five Nights at Freddy’s series. Check in-game for additional credits.
